# At least one search parameter must be set, and filters don't count

**Claim.** A request with no search parameter is refused outright — even one that sets paging or filter parameters. `contactMode` is a filter, not a search parameter, so it alone does not satisfy the requirement either.

Applies to: `~1people/get`

## Observed exchange

_Paging alone is not a search._

```http
GET /people?%24top=5

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
      "text": "This endpoint requires at least one search parameter to be set.",
      "properties": [
        "All Arguments"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

_contactMode filters results but does not count as a search parameter._

```http
GET /people?contactMode=Person

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
      "text": "This endpoint requires at least one search parameter to be set.",
      "properties": [
        "All Arguments"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
